result.instructions: Tools for Vyfakturuj, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show my ten newest invoices with customer and total."; "Find the contact details for customer Acme Ltd in my address book."; "Which payment methods and number series do I have set up?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Vyfakturuj data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run vyfakturuj_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run vyfakturuj_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run vyfakturuj_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. vyfakturuj_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: vyfakturuj_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: Search documents (faktury, zalohove faktury, proformy, objednavky ...); pass sort=date_created~desc for the newest first. Each row has id, number, type, dates, customer, VS, currency, total, flags and flags_decoded (paid, sent_to_customer, cancelled, ...) and the public/PDF URLs; use vyfakturuj_get_invoice for the whole document with items. Filter by free text q, customer id, document type, number, variable symbol (VS), currency or creation date range. Paged with rows_limit/rows_offset. GET /invoice/.

id_customer.description: Only invoices of this address-book contact (from vyfakturuj_list_contacts).

type.description: Document type: 1 faktura, 2 zalohova faktura, 4 proforma, 8 vyzva k platbe, 16 danovy doklad, 32 opravny danovy doklad, 64 prijmovy doklad, 128 opravny doklad, 512 objednavka.

date_created_from.description: Created on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

date_created_to.description: Created on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

sort.description: Sort: column~asc or column~desc, several joined by | (for example date_created~desc|number~asc).

rows_offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous reply.

tools.name: vyfakturuj_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: One document with all fields: supplier and customer blocks, items (text, quantity, unit_price, vat_rate, totals), dates, VS, bank details, total, flags and flags_decoded, payment method, public page, PDF and online-payment URLs. GET /invoice/{id}/.

tools.name: vyfakturuj_create_invoice
tools.title: Create an invoice (issues a real numbered document)
tools.description: WRITE. Creates a document in Vyfakturuj. Vyfakturuj has NO draft state: the document is issued at once and takes the next number of its number series (delete or cancel it in Vyfakturuj if wrong). Does NOT send an e-mail to the customer, does NOT mark it paid and moves no money; automatic reminders and paid notices are switched off for it (disable_automated_mails). Name the customer with id_customer (an address-book contact, from vyfakturuj_list_contacts) or with the customer_* fields. Items need text and unit_price. Optional id_number_series / id_payment_method come from vyfakturuj_list_number_series / vyfakturuj_list_payment_methods; the account defaults apply otherwise. Prices are net unless calculate_vat is 2 (gross). POST /invoice/.

unit_price.description: Price per unit, in the invoice currency. Net or gross depending on calculate_vat.

unit.description: Unit, e.g. ks, kg, hod (max 10 characters).

vat_rate.description: VAT rate in percent, e.g. 21, 12 or 0.

type.description: Document type: 1 faktura (default), 2 zalohova faktura, 4 proforma faktura, 8 vyzva k platbe, 512 objednavka.

id_customer.description: Address-book contact id (from vyfakturuj_list_contacts); fills the customer block.

customer_country_code.description: ISO 3166 country code, e.g. CZ, SK, DE.

id_number_series.description: Number series id (from vyfakturuj_list_number_series); must match the document type.

calculate_vat.description: 1 items are net (VAT added), 2 items are gross, 3 special VAT regime, 4 domestic reverse charge, 5 not a VAT payer, 6 foreign reverse charge.

VS.description: Variable symbol (default: derived from the number).

annotations.title: Create an invoice (issues a real numbered document)

tools.name: vyfakturuj_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: Search the address book (adresar): id, name, company, ICO (IC), DIC, address, e-mail (mail_to), phone, default days_due. Filter by free text q, ICO, DIC, name, e-mail or phone. Paged with rows_limit/rows_offset. GET /contact/.

sort.description: Sort: column~asc or column~desc, several joined by | (for example date_created~desc|number~asc).

rows_offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0). Use next_offset from the previous reply.

tools.name: vyfakturuj_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: One address-book contact with every field (billing and delivery address, ICO/DIC, e-mails, default texts and days_due). GET /contact/{id}/.

tools.name: vyfakturuj_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: WRITE. Adds a contact to the address book (it is not a customer message: nothing is sent). Give at least a name (the address-book label) or company or last name. Returns the new contact with its id. POST /contact/.

country_code.description: ISO 3166 country code, e.g. CZ, SK, DE.

mail_to.description: E-mail where invoices and reminders go.

days_due.description: Default days until due for this contact.

tools.name: vyfakturuj_get_template
tools.title: Get a recurring-invoice template
tools.description: One template / recurring invoice (sablona, pravidelna faktura) by id: its items, customer, schedule and settings. The API has no list endpoint for templates, so the id comes from the user (the number in the template's URL in Vyfakturuj). GET /template/{id}/.

tools.name: vyfakturuj_list_payment_methods
tools.title: List payment methods
tools.description: The payment methods of the account (id_payment_method, name, type: 1 bank transfer, 2 cash, 4 cash on delivery, 8 card, ...). Use the id in vyfakturuj_create_invoice. GET /settings/payment-method/.

tools.name: vyfakturuj_list_number_series
tools.title: List number series
tools.description: The numbering series (ciselne rady) of the account: id_number_series, the document type it is for, name and the number pattern. Use the id in vyfakturuj_create_invoice. GET /settings/number-series/.

tools.name: vyfakturuj_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: The tags (stitky) of the account: id_tag, name and colour. Invoices carry an id_tag. GET /settings/tags/.
